## Behavior

What happened, and what did you expect?

## Reproduction

List exact steps using a synthetic project. Do not attach private source, credentials or browser profiles.

## Environment and evidence

Commit or source fingerprint, local modifications, Windows/browser/WebView2 version, application version, and native versus browser versus MOCK runtime. Include sanitized logs and reproducible tests.

## Impact and recovery

State whether unsaved data remains available. Do not clear storage or reinstall before preserving recovery data. Report security-sensitive issues privately using SECURITY.md.
